meta.title: Nguepi Roland & Guessi Jasmine — Traditional Wedding Celebration
meta.description: Official invitation to the traditional marriage ceremony and presentation of family gifts of Nguepi Roland and Guessi Jasmine, on December 1, 2026 in Bangangté, West Region, Cameroon.

intro.subtitle: Traditional marriage ceremony & presentation of family gifts

hero.lead: With joy and surrounded by our families, we warmly invite you to share a day of tradition, fellowship, and celebration on the occasion of our union.

countdown.pastMessage: Thank you for sharing this day with us.

union.title: One union, two families
union.text: Beyond our personal story, this day celebrates the meeting of our families, the passing down of their values, and the joy of building a new chapter of our lives together.

pillars.hospitalityText: Welcoming our loved ones to the bride’s family village in Bangangté is an honor that roots our commitment in family warmth.
pillars.traditionText: Every gesture and word from the elders seals mutual esteem between our two lineages in a spirit of peace and joy.
pillars.transmissionText: From this gathering springs a shared journey, carried by family blessings and the kindness of those who surround us.

union.parentsTitle: With the Blessings of Our Families
union.decorCaption: Traditional ceremonial setting and heritage indigo textiles

program.title: The Five Moments of Our Gathering
program.scheduleNotice: Detailed timings will be announced soon
program.contextDisclaimer: This program outlines the main moments planned by our two families for this traditional marriage ceremony and presentation of family gifts in Bangangté.

steps.title: Welcome and Greetings
steps.summary: Arrival of the groom’s family delegation and warm opening remarks.
bullets: Arrival of the groom’s family at the bride’s family home, in a joyful atmosphere of songs and dances.
Words of welcome and opening exchanges led by the spokespersons of both families.

steps.title: The Playful Search for the Bride
steps.summary: A joyful custom in which the groom is invited to recognize his bride.
bullets: Presentation of several veiled women or women wrapped in traditional cloths.
The groom is invited to recognize his future bride.
According to the playful custom organized by the families, a mistake may call for a symbolic token before continuing.

steps.title: Presentation and Acceptance of Family Gifts
steps.summary: Respectful presentation of the agreed family gifts and the bride’s consent.
bullets: Review of the symbolic gifts brought in accordance with the custom agreed upon between the two families.
Request for the bride’s consent to accept the gifts honoring the union.
Joyful applause and celebration upon the announcement of her acceptance.

steps.title: Blessings and Counsel from the Elders
steps.summary: Words of wisdom, heritage transmission, and blessings from parents and elders.
bullets: Symbolic moment arranged by the families according to their customs.
Spoken counsel, wishes, and blessings offered by the parents and elders.

steps.title: Celebration and Feast
steps.summary: Shared banquet, music, dancing, and fellowship uniting both families.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This website was created exclusively for the traditional wedding celebration of Nguepi Roland and Guessi Jasmine and for sharing memories among family and friends.

sections.title: 1. No Advertising Tracking or Profiling
sections.body: This website uses no advertising cookies, commercial trackers, or facial recognition. RSVP responses are sent directly by you via WhatsApp to the organizing contact.

sections.title: 2. Photo Protection & Automatic EXIF Removal
sections.body: When a guest uploads a photo to the family album, the image is processed to strip EXIF metadata—including GPS coordinates—before storage. No photo geolocation data is stored or displayed.

sections.title: 3. Moderation & Access Control
sections.body: All guest-submitted photos remain in 'pending' status and are invisible to the public until approved by the organizers. The album can be protected by a server-verified guest access code and is excluded from search engine indexing.

sections.title: 4. Retention Period & Removal Requests
sections.body: Family album photos are retained for a duration configurable by the couple (24 months by default). Anyone pictured in a photo may request its modification or immediate removal by contacting the organizers.
